description: This file defines the CheckedNumeric template class for safe numeric operations with range checking, including arithmetic operators, conversions, and validation methods. It is part of the base/numerics module in Chromium, focusing on checked mathematical computations.

classes.name: CheckedNumeric
classes.description: A template class providing safe, range-checked arithmetic operations for numeric types.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current CheckedNumeric value is valid within its range.

methods.name: AssignIfValid
methods.description: Assigns the value to a result pointer if valid, returns success status.

methods.name: ValueOrDie
methods.description: Returns the underlying value or crashes if invalid.

methods.name: ValueOrDefault
methods.description: Returns the value or a default if invalid.

methods.name: Cast
methods.description: Casts to a different numeric type, preserving validity.

methods.name: Abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of the numeric.

methods.name: Max
methods.description: Returns the maximum of the current value and a given value.

methods.name: Min
methods.description: Returns the minimum of the current value and a given value.

methods.name: UnsignedAbs
methods.description: Returns the unsigned absolute value, handling signed min.
